Friday just got a permanent address 🍬🔥 Candy Shop is OPEN every single Friday at Azucar, and this week DJ Ralphy Ray is behind the decks running the whole sugar rush from start to finish. Think candy-coated beats, a room dripping in neon sweetness, and energy that doesn't quit till 2am. This is the one you put on repeat, mi gente — same night, same spot, new flavor of chaos every week. Pull up early, stay late, and let Ralphy Ray set the tone for your whole weekend. Candy Shop doesn't do boring Fridays. 🍭

📅 Every Friday • Doors 9PM-2AM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $5 Cover
🔞 18+ to party, 21+ to drink

Here's why you don't skip Candy Shop 👀🍬 Skittles Flights are back with a brand new flavor of the week — yes, it's a whole lineup of shots that taste like the candy aisle and hit twice as hard. Pair that with $5 cover and ladies drinking free before 11pm, and there's zero reason to sit this Friday out. Doors swing open at 9pm, the night runs till 2am, and DJ Ralphy Ray keeps the candy-coated beats flowing the whole time. Sweet tooth, spicy night — that's the whole vibe. Come taste the flavor everybody's gonna be talking about. 🍭🥂
